## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-10-10 — do not edit manually*

### Workflow
*~4,000 tokens/session saved*
- Do not rewrite `src/App.jsx` (or `src/main.jsx`, `src/lib/supabase.js`) repeatedly: it was written 3x in one session (messages 91, 146, 170). Decide the final wiring (Supabase vs. mock `services/tasks.js`) first, then write once; use Edit for later small changes.
- When swapping service implementations, keep the real one as `tasks.supabase.js` and change only the import in one place rather than re-creating App.jsx and main.jsx.

### Environment
*~3,000 tokens/session saved*
- Shell is Git Bash on Windows: `gh` CLI is not installed (don't call `gh`; use `git remote add origin <url>` + `git push`). Node v24, npm 11, git 2.46 are available.
- Avoid large multi-file heredocs (`cat > file <<'EOF'`) in a single Bash call: a quoting/EOF error (exit 2, 'unexpected EOF') forced a redo. Use the Write tool for each source file instead.

### Project Facts
*~1,500 tokens/session saved*
- Project is a Vite + React + Tailwind app (`src/{components,pages,hooks,lib,services,context}`, `supabase/migrations`). Verify changes with `npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5`; dev server runs on `localhost:5173`.
- `claude.md` at repo root is ~18KB; read it once at session start and don't re-cat it.
